title: The Story of Village Palampur
subtitle: Understanding the Fundamentals of Economics and Production
subject: Social Science (Economics)
author: Shine Academy EduOS
learning_outcomes: Understand the basic concepts of production.
Identify the factors of production: Land, Labour, Physical Capital, and Human Capital.
Analyze farming and non-farming activities in a village economy.

ai_context.learning_goal: Master the factors of production and understand rural economic structures through the hypothetical village of Palampur.
common_misconceptions: Confusing physical capital with human capital.
Assuming farming is the only activity in rural areas.
ai_context.tutor_hint: If the student struggles with factors of production, ask them what they would need to start a small clay-pot business.
